member.name: T:Regalis.Domain.Entities.Finance.Quotation
member.summary:
TRN_Quotation — the priced offer that precedes an invoice (document §6). This is where "Draft" lives: a quotation is freely editable while Draft, and the invoice it becomes is immutable from the moment it is issued. Customer, company and tax details are snapshotted when the quotation is sent, so the customer's copy and the resulting invoice agree even if settings or the profile change afterwards.
A sent quotation is never edited again. New prices or terms go out as a revision (…-R1), which is a fresh row pointing back through while the one the customer already holds is marked Revised — so the document they approve is always exactly the document they were sent.

member.name: T:Regalis.Domain.Enums.PurchaseOrderStatus
member.summary:
Purchase order lifecycle from document §4/§20. PartiallyReceived and Received are derived from the lines' ReceivedQuantity, never set by hand.
Draft → PendingApproval → Approved → Sent → PartiallyReceived → Received, with Cancelled reachable until goods arrive. When Purchase.RequireApproval is off an approver takes a Draft straight to Approved. The values are stored, so the two approval states were appended (6, 7) rather than renumbering the lifecycle.
